summary: AMTD IDEA Group filed a Form 6-K attaching an announcement by its subsidiary, The Generation Essentials Group (TGE), of a share repurchase program and a voluntary lock-up by its controlling shareholder. TGE's board authorized up to $10 million in open-market or private repurchases, to be funded from existing cash, aiming to enhance shareholder value given the stock's discount to net asset value. The controlling shareholder, AMTD Digital, along with directors and management, agreed to a two-year lock-up on TGE shares. The repurchases are subject to Rule 10b-18/10b5-1 compliance. Ordinary-course buyback with a controlling-shareholder lock-up; no tender offer premium or specific price terms. Watch for execution pace and asset value updates from recent hotel acquisitions.
